brief.ptype: sharing a practical tip that worked

title: Low balance led to a 50% increase in overdraft fees
body: Last semester I was living off my credit card due to low bank balances. After one particularly large bill came through, I realized I had 0 dollars left and couldn't afford lunch. After that, I transferred $500 from my savings to my checking account every month until it got back up to around $1k. Now I have a decent emergency fund in place and no overdraft fees for the first time this year.
